text: いい　つりざおを　つかえば　いい　ポケモンが　つれるんだが…

structure.jp: いい　つりざおを　つかえば
structure.en: if you use a Good Rod

structure.jp: いい　ポケモンが　つれるんだが…
structure.en: you can catch good Pokémon, but...

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: ば on a verb means 'if'. つかえば = 'if you use'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing つる to つれる makes it 'can catch'; the thing caught takes が. いい　ポケモンが　つれる = 'good Pokémon can be caught'.

patterns.name: 〜んだが
patterns.explanation: んだ explains how things are, and が left hanging at the end means 'but...', leaving the rest unsaid. つれるんだが = 'you can catch them, but...'
